name: The Breakers Plaza CRM
summary: A condominium CRM that centralizes residents, maintenance fees, shared-area reservations, beach amenity requests, and maintenance work.
functions: Manages residents and fees, synchronizes payments with QuickBooks, validates SUM availability, processes beach amenity requests, and records maintenance work.
problem: Resident data, payments, reservations, and amenity requests were handled separately, causing lost requests, scheduling conflicts, and duplicate accounting entries.
solution: I mapped the administrative workflow and built a centralized system with QuickBooks payment synchronization, real-time reservation validation, online requests, and staff training.

demo.title: Private system
demo.description: Public access is unavailable because the condominium platform contains sensitive resident, payment, reservation, and operational data.
